purpose: Define auditable longitudinal learning loops for amenities, mission human factors, acoustics, sensory R&D, lighting, IEQ/energy, Eco-Grex and P-infinity configuration assurance.
privacy_rule: Prefer anonymous/aggregate environmental, maintenance and operational evidence; personal/biometric data requires a justified use, governance and minimisation.
learning_rule: Positive, neutral, negative and failed findings remain part of the evidence record; no cherry-picking.
timing_rule: P30/P90/P365 are optional internal learning checkpoints only; event-driven reanalysis remains primary and no statutory interval is inferred.
